addons.name: Air & pollen
addons.description: Air quality, today’s pollen for grass, trees and weeds, and UV, for the place set in Settings → Weather. From Open-Meteo, like the weather.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Bin day
addons.description: Which bins go out next and when. From the evening before it says to put them out; tap it once they are out.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Birthdays
addons.description: Birthdays coming up, with faces, from the people Immich recognises in your photos. Set a date of birth on a person in Immich and they appear here.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Calendar
addons.description: Upcoming events from one or more published calendar links, as a schedule or a month.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Grid carbon
addons.description: How clean the electricity is right now in your region, the next day as bars, and the greenest three hours to run the washing machine or dishwasher. From National Grid ESO — no key needed.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Certificates
addons.description: Days left on your sites’ HTTPS certificates, the soonest to expire first — so a renewal that quietly failed is caught before visitors see a warning.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Chores & rewards
addons.description: A column per person with today’s chores to tap off. Each earns stars; a weekly goal unlocks a reward. "Anyone" chores appear for everybody and go to whoever does them. Resets each Monday.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Clock
addons.description: The time, with the date underneath.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Countdowns
addons.description: Days until the things you are looking forward to — birthdays, holidays, trips. The soonest first.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Fuel prices
addons.description: The cheapest petrol or diesel near home, from the prices Asda, Shell, JET, Applegreen, Morrisons, Moto, MFG, Rontec and SGN publish under the UK’s open fuel price scheme — no key needed.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: GitHub repository
addons.description: Stars, issues, pull requests, releases and a weekly commit chart for your GitHub repositories — a tab each — and, with a token, who has been visiting. No token needed for public ones.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Home Assistant bridge
addons.description: Home Assistant as a starship’s console, for a page of its own: its rooms down the side, and each room’s lights and switches to tap, its temperatures, and all its lights on or off at once.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Electricity
addons.description: Electricity used and what it cost — today, this week, this month or the last twelve, each against the one before, as bars. From your smart meter: today through Home Assistant, and the longer views from Bright, with its login in Settings. About half an hour behind, as the meter is.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: On this day in history
addons.description: Something that happened on this date, from Wikipedia — a new one every half minute, or tap for the next.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Home Assistant
addons.description: Home Assistant entities you pick — temperatures, who is home, what is playing — each as a small card. Lights and switches change with a tap; locks and doors are only ever shown.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Homey
addons.description: Sixteen tiles for a Homey hub: devices, rooms, lights, flows, light colour, fans, the whole house, moods, alerts, climate, energy, history, who’s home, variables, the timeline and the hub itself.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Photo
addons.description: A photo from your Immich server — at random from the whole library, or from one album. Changes on a timer, and on a tap.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Photo albums
addons.description: The albums on your Immich server: tap one for its photos, a slideshow or a video; search the whole library by who, where or when; pick several albums for one slideshow. Opens the whole album browser too, and the top bar's Photos button comes here.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Immich library
addons.description: Your Immich library in numbers — photos, videos, how much space it takes, how many added lately — with the newest photos along the bottom.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: LAN speed test
addons.description: Speed between this panel and another machine on your network, using a self-hosted OpenSpeedTest server. Tap to run. Measures your own wiring rather than your internet connection.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Lights
addons.description: Govee lights and plugs. Tap one to switch it, drag along its bar for brightness, tap a colour. Works over the home network for devices with LAN Control turned on in the Govee app, or through Govee with an API key.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Stocks & crypto
addons.description: Share prices and indices from Yahoo Finance, and coin prices from CoinGecko, each with its move and a small chart.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Meal plan
addons.description: The week’s dinners: tonight’s large, tomorrow’s underneath. After dinner time it moves on to tomorrow.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: On this day
addons.description: Your photos from this date in past years, from Immich’s memories, with how long ago and where. Tap or swipe for the next.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: News feed
addons.description: Headlines from any RSS or Atom feed.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Notes
addons.description: Sticky notes for the household. Share text from the phone app, or post one from any phone on the home network at the editor’s address followed by /notes. Tap a note, then Done, to take it down.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Omarchy hotkeys
addons.description: The Omarchy keyboard shortcuts as a cheat sheet, one section at a time. Tap a section to jump to it, or tap the sheet to turn the page. Sized for a page of its own.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Parcels
addons.description: Parcels on their way: share a tracking link or number to the panel from the phone app — a Royal Mail, DPD, Evri or Yodel email, a courier’s page — and it goes on this list. With a tracking service set below, each is looked up every half an hour and pops up when it is out for delivery or has come. Tap one for its story and its carrier’s page.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Planes overhead
addons.description: The aircraft in the sky around home: who they are, where they’re flying from and to, how high, and which way to look. From adsb.lol, the open network of volunteer ADS-B receivers, and adsbdb — no key needed.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Radio
addons.description: Internet radio on the panel’s speakers. Pick stations from around the world, or add any stream by its address, then tap one to tune in. It keeps playing when the dashboard turns the page. Given a page to itself it can show the song’s cover and what played before, an old set’s tuning dial, or a grid of stations.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Railcam
addons.description: Lineside cameras from railcam.uk: pick any of its 300 and touch one to watch it live on the panel — or have them playing in the tile, small and silent. Needs your own railcam.uk account — supporters’ cameras, a supporter’s.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Rain soon
addons.description: Whether it is about to rain: the next two hours in a sentence — "Rain from 14:20, light" — and as bars. For the place in Settings → Weather.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Reminders
addons.description: Reminders shared from the phone app — “Remind me to put the bins out at 7pm”, “Don’t forget the dentist tomorrow at 9:30”. Said aloud when they fall due; tap one when it’s done.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Sea state
addons.description: The sea at a place you choose: its level against the mean, how high the waves are, and how warm the water is. From Open-Meteo, which asks for no key.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Servers
addons.description: CPU, memory, disk and temperature for this Pi and your other machines, and whether their containers are running. Other machines need Glances — on CasaOS, one click in its app store.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Services
addons.description: A light per thing that should be up — Immich, CasaOS, the router, the Mac mini — with how quickly it answers. Tap one to check again, or to wake a sleeping computer.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: StreamingSoundtracks
addons.description: StreamingSoundtracks.com — film, game and TV scores — on the panel’s speakers, with the album and its cover, how far through the track is, what is coming up and who asked for it, and what played before. Or one of its sister stations: 1980s.FM, Adagio.FM, Death.FM or Entranced.FM.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Shopping list
addons.description: One list the whole house shares. Add to it from any phone on the home network at the editor’s address followed by /list; tap an item on the panel to tick it off. Ticked items clear themselves after half a day.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Floatplane & Nebula
addons.description: The latest videos from the creators you follow on Floatplane and Nebula, to watch on the panel.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Mastodon & Bluesky
addons.description: Your Mastodon and Bluesky timelines, notifications, lists and feeds, signed in.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Speed test
addons.description: Runs Ookla speedtest and shows download and upload on one dial as it goes, with ping, jitter and packet loss. Tap to start. Needs the speedtest CLI installed — see INSTALL.md.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Now playing
addons.description: The current track with transport controls. Shows Spotify when it is active, otherwise the phone over Bluetooth. The artwork moves to suit the tile’s shape.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Sun & moon
addons.description: Sunrise and sunset, where the sun is now, how fast the days are changing, and the moon’s phase. Worked out on the panel from the place set in Settings → Weather.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: London transport
addons.description: Whether the Tube, Elizabeth line, Overground, DLR and trams are running, and the next arrivals at your stop.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Abyss
addons.description: Deep water: blue light from above, cyan from below, and very clear glass tiles with big round corners.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Aurora
addons.description: Glass after dark: frosted tiles over an inky black lit from two corners at once — violet from the top left, teal from the bottom right — with light catching the top of each pane and a mint accent between the two glows.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Ember
addons.description: Warm and dark: a smouldering brown-black gradient, tiles tinted with firelight and an orange accent.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Espresso
addons.description: Warm and bookish: flat coffee-brown tiles with no edges or shadows, a serif face and a caramel accent.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Forest
addons.description: Woodland after dusk: a deep green-black gradient, tiles tinted with mint and a fresh green accent.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Frost
addons.description: Glass in daylight: frosted white panes on pale ice blue, a white bloom from the top left, and light along each pane's top edge.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: LCARS
addons.description: A starship's console: black, with flat bars of orange, lilac and blue swept round the corner of every panel, block buttons and tall condensed capitals. The whole kiosk dresses as one — Settings, the albums, the player — not only the dashboard.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Midnight
addons.description: A calm night blue: a navy gradient, soft translucent tiles and a sky-blue accent. The dashboard's first look.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Nightstand
addons.description: Deliberately plain and very high contrast: no panels, white on true black with an amber accent. Readable across a room, and the safest choice for an always-on panel, since so little of it is lit.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Obsidian
addons.description: Black lacquer: solid tiles rather than glass, with a strong gloss along the top and a champagne-gold accent. Glossy rather than glassy.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Paper
addons.description: Light and quiet: white cards on warm off-white paper, dark ink and a burnt-orange accent. No glass, no shadows.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Sorbet
addons.description: Sweets in a shop window: glossy near-white panes over a peach-to-pink wash, a coral accent and a rounded face.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Swiss
addons.description: International Typographic Style: flat white blocks on grey, square corners, wide gutters, black type and one signal red. No gloss, no glass, no shadow.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Synthwave
addons.description: Eighties neon: magenta and cyan light on deep purple, tiles edged in pink and glossed, in a techno face that stays readable.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Terminal
addons.description: A green-screen terminal: phosphor on black, hairline boxes, a monospaced face and the faintest glow, as off an old tube.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Terminal Night
addons.description: Terminal with the lights off: true black, no glow, boxes you only just see, and a softer green that is easy on the eyes in a dark room.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Tides
addons.description: High and low tide times, whether the water is coming in or going out, and the sea’s height through the day — anywhere on the coast. From Open-Meteo’s tide model, no key needed. Modelled, not measured: fine for a walk on the beach, not for navigation.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Timers
addons.description: Kitchen timers. Tap a time to start one, tap its ring to pause, hold to cancel. When one is done it plays a sound and says which timer it was; tap the ring to stop it. They keep running when you leave the dashboard.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Traffic cameras
addons.description: Live pictures from the roads: any of London’s 900 TfL JamCams, found by road name or nearest home, or any other camera whose picture has a web address. Tap one to see it large. No key needed.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Train departures
addons.description: The next trains from your station, like the board on the platform: time, where to, platform, and whether it is on time. From Realtime Trains — it needs a free token from api-portal.rtt.io.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Departures (Europe & US)
addons.description: The next trains, trams, subways or buses from any station or stop across most of Europe and North America — the Netherlands, Germany, Switzerland, the Nordics, New York, Boston, Washington DC, Los Angeles and more — live where the operator shares it. From Transitous, the open journey planner — no key needed.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: TV remote
addons.description: Controls a Hisense VIDAA television: power, volume, channel and a direction pad. Set the address in Settings → Television.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: UniFi network
addons.description: Six tiles for a UniFi network: its health, who’s home, devices, clients, WAN throughput and the router’s own speed test.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Updates
addons.description: Updates waiting across the house: Immich against its latest release, Home Assistant’s own updates, and UniFi firmware — in one list, or a tick when there are none.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: Weather
addons.description: Current conditions and a short forecast. Uses the location set in Settings → Weather.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox

addons.name: YouTube
addons.description: The latest videos from your YouTube subscriptions: touch one to watch it on the panel. Can instead play one video in the tile, muted or with sound.
addons.author: Vincent Willcox
